findings.title: P02S owns structured-file edits but explicitly prohibits performing them
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4: “P02S owns all structured file edits.”
findings.trigger: A downstream execution must apply an inventory-required TOML, JSON, or YAML edit.
findings.consequence: P02S cannot perform the edit because its prompt prohibits live structured-file changes, while no other prompt owns those changes; the required transformations therefore have no executable owner.
findings.evidence: The manifest assigns P02S `structured_file_transformations_all_formats`, `pyproject_toml_identity_updates`, `requirements_file_updates`, and `ci_workflow_yaml_updates`. However, `P02S_structured_data_codemod.prompt.v3.yaml` says: “Do not edit live TOML/JSON/YAML files; downstream owners apply the proven codemod.” No downstream manifest entry owns those units.

findings.title: No exact acceptance-criterion ownership map exists
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 5 pass condition: “20 criteria mapped, each with exactly one owner, Criterion 20 owned by P08.”
findings.trigger: QA attempts to enumerate the primary owner of each specification criterion from 1 through 20.
findings.consequence: Exact completeness, uniqueness, and Criterion 20 ownership cannot be verified, so acceptance traceability is unsatisfied.
findings.evidence: `prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml` contains only prompt metadata, dependencies, and abstract `owns` mutation-unit lists; it has no acceptance-criteria mapping. The v5 checkpoint likewise supplies no 1–20 mapping. P08 describes comprehensive CLI testing but does not explicitly assign specification Criterion 20 to P08.

findings.title: An existing downstream v3 prompt was modified in place
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 requires that no existing artifact be overwritten and that revised artifacts use new versions; Criterion 6 requires downstream v3 templates to remain unmodified.
findings.trigger: The checkpoint delta is evaluated against the repository baseline.
findings.consequence: The checkpoint violates its versioning and repair-authority boundary, so prior artifacts are not preserved byte-for-byte.
findings.evidence: Git status reports `M plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/P02S_structured_data_codemod.prompt.v3.yaml`. The v5 checkpoint explicitly lists that existing v3 file under “FILES MODIFIED,” while the P00A prompt requires revised artifacts to use a strictly newer/new versioned filename and the stated repair authority does not extend to downstream prompt modification.

reasoning: P00A schema validation succeeds, the manifest contains 13 entries with nonempty disjoint ownership labels and more than 20 unique units, and the P00 evidence appears independently passed. Those successes do not cure the executable ownership contradiction, absent 20-criterion mapping, or in-place modification of an existing downstream prompt; each directly defeats a stated blocker criterion.
